data.name: The Troma Project
data.detailed_description:
WARNING: Originally completed in the year 2001 this game was never released. It contains extensive swearing, rude language, sex, crime, splatter Horror - everything what was not acceptable for a Video game 15 years ago. If you play this game, please do not take anything too serious.

Welcome to Tromaville!

A beautiful little hellhole where toxic waste, bad taste, mutant violence, cheap heroism, and deeply questionable life choices all leak into the same sewer.

Originally completed in 2001 and unreleased at the time, The Troma Project throws you into the world of Troma and Toxic Mayhem: a turn-based strategy game starring The Toxic Avenger, Sgt. Kabukiman NYPD, and Super Tromette Tiffany Shepis.

The once-peaceful streets of Tromaville have been overrun by vicious Surf-Nazis, turning the town into a blood-soaked battlefield. Behind the chaos lurks a devil-worshipping mega-conglomerate — and only two unlikely heroes are filthy enough to clean up the mess: The Toxic Avenger and Sgt. Kabukiman NYPD.

Across seven chapters full of fun and gore, fight your way from Tromaville to Arabia, Motumbuland, and other strange places around the globe. Collect a filthy pile of Tromatic weapons, drugs, drinks, and other useful — or deeply irresponsible — items. Mix your own drinks, mess around with your inventory, make target shots, blow up cars, and take mission advice from Lloyd Kaufman himself.

Follow the whole deranged mess through full-screen Tromatic movie cutscenes packed with blood, gore, rude language, splatter horror, crime, sex, and all the things that made this game too wrong for its time.

This is not clean nostalgia.

This is not a polished superhero product.

This is Troma: a toxic little strategy-game freakshow from the age of CD-ROM excess — loud, gross, weird, funny, offensive by design, cheap in all the right places, completely unwilling to behave, and still leaking something green after all these years.

Key Features

Turn-based strategy from the Troma vault
Lead The Toxic Avenger and Sgt. Kabukiman NYPD through a tactical trash-cinema freakshow full of mutant mayhem and gore.

Seven chapters full of fun and gore
Travel from Tromaville to Arabia, Motumbuland, and other strange places in a long, filthy journey across the globe.

Tromatic full-screen movie cutscenes
Follow the storyline through outrageous full-screen video sequences filled with Troma blood, slime, bad taste, and splatter-horror insanity.

Weapons, drugs, drinks, and other terrible ideas
Collect a filthy pile of Tromatic weapons, drugs, drinks, and useful — or deeply irresponsible — items.

Inventory chaos and environmental mayhem
Mix drinks, mess around with your equipment, make target shots, blow up cars, and use whatever the game is irresponsible enough to hand you.

Lloyd Kaufman mission advice
At the beginning of every mission, Lloyd Kaufman himself gives you advice on how to survive the next dose of Toxic Mayhem.

A filthy original soundtrash

More than 25 tracks of dirty, loud, genre-bending music from the original release, featuring Nevermore, The Loose Nuts, songs from Troma movies, and more.

Original-era bonus material
Includes selected extras from the original PC CD-ROM release, keeping the early-2000s Troma package intact.

Too wrong for its time
Originally completed in 2001, The Troma Project arrives as a cult PC oddity: part turn-based strategy game, part interactive Troma archive, part radioactive fever dream.

reviews.review:
Honestly, this game is worth it for the intro and Lloyd Kaufman's copious narration, but if you're not a fan of Troma, then I would skip this one. The game isn't the greatest, and obviously it is quite dated.

Giving this a thumbs up because Troma rules.
